chapter.verse: Saul in Topa’ nungzuite langpanin tawng a, thah dingin nakpi-in a nakkhiat lai takin,

hih Lampi a zui numeite ahi zongin, pasalte ahi zongin a muh ciangin, khau tawh a khih khit ciangin Jerusalem khua-ah paipih dingin Damaskas khua kikhopna inn ukte kiangah vaikhakna lai piak nading siampi ukpa kiangah a ngen hi.
Amah lam pai a, Damaskas khua a naih ciangin vantung pan khuavakpi in ama kimkot ah thakhatin a taang hi.
Amah in lei tungah puksuk a, “Saul aw, Saul aw, bang dingin kei hong bawlsia na hi hiam?” a cihna aw a za hi.
Saul in, “Topa aw, kua na hi hiam?” ci-in a dong hi. Zeisu in, “Na hong bawlsiat Zeisu ka hi hi, ciang hiam na khe tawh peek leteh a haksa hi;
Ahih hangin tho in la, khua sungah tum in, na gamtat nadingin thu hong kihilh ding hi,” a ci hi.
Saul tawh a paikhawm mite in tua aw a zak uh hangin kuamah mu loin, pau thei loin, ding-in a om uh hi.
Saul lei pan a thawh ciangin a mit hak a, kuamah mu thei lo ahih maninah amaute in a khut len uh a, Damaskas khua-ah a paipih uh hi.
Ni thum sung tawntung bangmah mu loin, an ne lo, tui dawn loin a om hi.
Tua lai takin Damakas khua-ah Ananias kici nungzuipa khat a om hi. Tua pa a mang sungah Topa in, “Ananias aw,” ci-in a sap leh, Ananias in, “Ka om hi, Topa aw,” a ci hi.
Topa in “Tho in la, Tang a kici lampi-ah pai in; Saul kici Tarsas mi, Judah innah va zong in.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah in thungen a, Ananias kicipa khat a kiangah hong pai-in, ama khua muh nading a tungah a khut a nga khat, a mang sungah a mu zo hi,” ci-in a sawl hi.
Ananias in, “Topa aw, hih pa in Jerusalem khua-ah na misiangtho hi zah tak a bawlsiatna thu mi tampi kiangah ka za zo hi.
Hi san takah zong na min tawh thungen khempeuh khau tawh hen nadingin siampi liante kiangah thu a ngah hi,” a ci hi.
Topa in, “Pai ta in. Bang hang hiam na cih leh, amah in Gentailte mai-ah ahi zongin, kumpite mai-ah ahi zongin, Israelte mai-ah ahi zongin, ka min a puak dingin ka teelsa beel ahi hi.
Keima min hangah bangzah takin a thuak nading ke’n ka lak ding hi,” ci-in a gen hi.

Ananias pai a, inn sungah lutin Saul tungah a khut nga a, “Ka nau Saul aw, na paina lampi-ah na kiangah hong kilang Topa Zeisu in khua na muhkik theih nading ahi zongin, Kha Siangtho tawh na dim nading ahi zongin, kei hong sawl hi,” a ci hi.
Tua lai takin thakhatin Saul’ mit tungah ngasa lip bangin na khat kia pah a, khua mu thei a,
tho-in a kibaptaiz khit ciangin an ne a, a thahat kik hi. Saul in Damaskas khua nungzuite tawh ni tawmkha omkhawm a,
‘Zeisu in Pasian’ Tapa hi’ ci-in kikhopna inn sungah thakhatin thu a hilh hi.

Thu a za mite in lamdang a sa uh a, “Hih pa in Jerusalem khua sungah tua min tawh thungente a bawlsiapa hilo ahi hiam? Amaute khau-in a hen khit ciangin siampi liante kiangah paipih dingin hih lai takah hong pai hi,” a ci uh hi.
Saul khangto-in siam semsem a, Judah mite’ thugenna hoih takin thukkikin, Zeisu in Khazih ahi takpi hi, ci-in a lak hi.
Ni tampi a sawt khit ciangin Judah mite in Saul thah ding a vaihawm uh hi.
Amau vaihawmna thu Saul in a thei hi. Amaute in Saul thah nading kongpi kiangah sun leh zanin a pang uh hi.
Nungzuite in Saul zan lai takin la uh a, seeng khat sungah kulh tung pan amah a khiasuk uh hi.
Saul Jerusalem khua a tun’ ciangin nungzuite tawh kipawl ding a ut hangin amaute in Saul nungzui a suahna taksang loin a kihta uh hi.

Ahih hangin Barnabas in Pasian’ sawltakte kiangah Saul paipihin, amah in lampi-ah Zeisu a muhna thu ahi zongin, amah tawh a kihona thu ahi zongin, Damaskas khua-ah Zeisu’ min tawh lau loin thu hilhna thu ahi zongin a gen hi.
Saul in amaute tawh Jerusalem khua-ah omkhawm a, a pai zel, a ciah zel a,
lau loin Zeisu’ min tawh thu hilh a, Grik Judah mite tawh thu kinialin a om hi. Tuate in Saul thah nading a zong uh hi.
Ute naute in tua thu a zak uh ciangin Saul Kaisaria khua-ah a kha uh a, Tarsas khua-ah a paisak uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin Judah gam, Galile gam, Samaria gam mun khempeuh ah pawlpite in lungkimin kipna a ngah uh hi. Pasian kihtakna leh Kha Siangtho huhna tawh omin a khang semsem uh hi.
Tua lai takin Piter in mun khempeuh ah a kawivak lai takin Lidda khua-ah a om misiangthote kiangah a tung hi.
Tua khua-ah Aineas kici a khut a khe a si, kum giat tawntung a lupna tungah a om mi khat a mu hi.
Piter in, “Aineas aw, Zeisu in nang hong damsak zo hi. Tho in la, na lupna na phah in,” a cih ciangin amah in thakhatin a tho hi.
Lidda khua akipan Saron gamah a om mi khempeuhte in tua pa a muh uh ciangin Topa kiangah a kihei uh hi.
Joppa khua-ah Dorkas a cihnopna ahi Tabitha min nei, nungzui a suak numei khat a om hi. Tua numei in a pha gamtatna leh mi hehpihna lungsim a nei hi.
Tua lai takin amah a ci na a, a si hi. Amaute in ama luang a sil khit uh ciangin dei tungnung ah koih uh hi.
Lidda khua in Joppa khua tawh kinai ahih ciangin Piter tua khua-ah a om ci-in nungzuite in a theih uh ciangin mi nih sawl uh a, “Zekai loin ko kiangah hong pai in,” ci-in a thuum uh hi.

Piter tho a, amaute tawh paikhawm hi. A tun’ ciangin dei tungnung sungah a paipihto uh hi. Meigong khempeuh a kiangah a ding uh a, kapin, Dorkas in amaute tawh a omkhawm lai taka a bawlsa puan-akte leh puante a lak uh hi.
Piter in tua mi khempeuh a paikhiatsak khit ciangin khukdin’in thungen a, si-luang lam kihei-in, “Tabitha aw, tho in,” a ci hi.
Ama mit hak a, Piter a muh ciangin tho-in, a tu hi. Piter in a khut lenin a din’sak khit ciangin misiangthote leh meigongte sam a, Dorkas a nungta-in a lak hi.
Tua thu in Joppa khua-ah kithei khin a, mi tampi in Topa a um uh hi.
Piter in Joppa khua-ah savun bawlpa Simon kiangah sawt veipi a taam hi.
